title: Alone.
author: ATwy84
description:
This is a game I created for my Interactive media class at Umass Lowell. The game is based of the hallucinations and fear you would have as a kid when being alone. There is no end to this game. The idea is that you are stuck in a never ending loop of fear. To give the feeling that you are trapped in the situation.

Credits to the sounds I found on Freesound.org

https://freesound.org/s/268511/ (beautiful or ominous music box.wav by xtrgamr)

https://freesound.org/s/366111/ (Indoor Footsteps.wav by dkiller2204)

https://freesound.org/s/264593/ (cheap-tv-static.mp3 by vacuumfan7072)

These sounds are not my creation and I do not intend on claiming they are my work. However the images and story were my creation.
